applicabilityBasis.summary: senPYUSDmain is an ERC-4626 Morpho Vault V2 lending share over PYUSD. Its assets-per-share conversion changes with interest, fees and losses, and withdrawals depend on available underlying assets. The product, contract and governing terms describe a strategy position rather than a payment or settlement instrument with a fixed monetary redemption obligation under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: This assessment applies to senPYUSDmain at Ethereum address 0xb576765fb15505433af24fee2c0325895c559fb2, separately from underlying PYUSD. Sentora terms identify Sentora Digital Holdings (BVI) Ltd and its affiliates as the service counterparty. The vaults addendum describes direct smart-contract interactions, denies capital preservation guarantees and makes withdrawal subject to contract and protocol constraints. These disclosures do not establish a separate legal payment-stablecoin issuer or fixed monetary redemption obligor for the share, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. No GENIUS issuer authorization or registration is asserted. Underlying stablecoin approvals and reserve reports do not establish authorization or attestations for this vault share. This payment-stablecoin scope assessment does not determine securities-law treatment or authorize distribution of the yield product.
